Write the binomial expansion formula for $(1 - 2x)^5$:
$$(1 - 2x)^5 = \sum_{r=0}^5 \binom{5}{r}(1)^{5-r}(-2x)^r$$

Calculate the term containing $x^4$ ($r = 4$):
$$T_5 = \binom{5}{4}(1)^1(-2x)^4 = 5 \times 1 \times 16x^4 = 80x^4 \implies \text{Coefficient of } x^4 = 80$$

Calculate the term containing $x^5$ ($r = 5$):
$$T_6 = \binom{5}{5}(1)^0(-2x)^5 = 1 \times 1 \times (-32x^5) = -32x^5 \implies \text{Coefficient of } x^5 = -32$$

Identify the terms contributing to $x^5$ in the product $(1 + px)(1 - 2x)^5$:
$$\text{Term in } x^5 = 1 \times (-32x^5) + px \times (80x^4) = (-32 + 80p)x^5$$

Since there is no term in $x^5$, set the coefficient to zero:
$$-32 + 80p = 0 \implies 80p = 32 \implies p = \frac{32}{80} = \frac{2}{5} \quad (= 0.4)$$
